title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Machinist's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the stable field relay; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
